Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Kotzebue Office Kotzebue, AK 99752

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 28, 2026

CONTACT: Kevin Clark or Luke Henslee Kotzebue Area Manager and Assistant Manager (907) 442-3420 (800) 560-2271

Kotzebue Fishery Advisory Announcement #10

KOTZEBUE COMMERCIAL SALMON FISHING TO OPEN

Emergency Order: 3-S-X-09-26

Commercial Salmon Fishing:

Commercial fishing will open in the Kotzebue District as follows: • will open for 8 hours from 10:00 a.m. until 6:00 p.m. Sunday, August 30, • will open for 8 hours from 10:00 a.m. until 6:00 p.m. Monday, August 31.

Two buyers are currently registered to purchase salmon in Kotzebue this season.

The 2026 Kotzebue commercial harvest forecast is 50,000 to 150,000 chum salmon.

Permit holders are reminded to check with their buyers before starting fishing operations to ensure they have a market for their catch.

The commercial salmon season ends in the Kotzebue District by regulation 12:01 a.m on Tuesday, September 1. These two 8-hour commercial fishing periods will be the final commercial salmon openings in the Kotzebue District for the 2026 season.

If you have any questions concerning the fishery you can call the Kotzebue office at 907-442-3420, or the Commercial Fisheries office in Nome at 1-800-560-2271.
